WHAT WE ARRANGE FOR YOU

From the treatment principle to routine checks.

The training combines an explanation of the technology with practical familiarity with your own plant and its operation.

How the technology works

The treatment principle and the role of the individual parts of your specific WWTP.

Regular checks and maintenance

What to watch during operation and how to approach routine care of the equipment.

Operating problems

Basic fault diagnostics and guidance on dealing with operating difficulties.

Correct and economical operation

Recommendations on using the technology, based on your plant and how it is operated.

Consultation and support

Room for specific questions and expert technical support for the operator.

Practical and on site

Training right at the installed technology for the people who operate it.

A CLEAR SEQUENCE OF STEPS

The training is based on your technology.

Together we will specify the topics and scope according to the equipment and the operators' needs.

  1. 01

    Your equipment

    We discuss the type of WWTP, its location and who will be operating it.

  2. 02

    Practical explanation

    Right on site, we go through how the technology works and its individual parts.

  3. 03

    Day-to-day care

    We explain regular checks, maintenance and how to find your way around operating problems.

  4. 04

    Your questions

    We answer questions about operation and discuss any follow-up support you need.

BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

What you may want to know.

Do you have a specific installation or brief? Let's go through it together.

Is the training also for private owners of a domestic WWTP?+

Yes. We offer training to private owners as well as to treatment plant operators in businesses and municipalities.

Does the training take place right at the equipment?+

Yes. We offer practical training right at the place of installation, so that everything can be related to the specific technology.

Can we discuss specific operating difficulties?+

Yes. Our offer includes basic diagnostics of operating problems, expert consultations and technical support. Briefly describe your questions when you make your enquiry.
